target.statement: Mean percentage improvement in MSE over RF(10) for EST-PD(Norm) on the CCPP dataset (12.39, SE 0.15), averaged over training sizes 50-500 with 100 bootstrap replications each

compute.basis: 10-tree random forests on <=500-sample bootstrap subsets of a small UCI table, with gradient-based OOB smoothing-parameter optimisation; 6 training sizes x 100 replications x several baselines is pure CPU sklearn work, minutes to ~1-2 hours on 8 cores.

blockers: Full 100-replication x 6-size protocol is somewhat long on CPU; a reduced-replication run may not match the SE exactly
Requires reimplementing/using the repo's custom smoothed-RF code and OOB optimiser
title: Improving Random Forests by Smoothing
